item.title: Coco
item.description: Coco is an adorable puppy who’s still learning the basics. She’s very smart and eager to please, making her a great candidate for training.

item.title: Charlie
item.description: Charlie is a fun-loving puppy who’s always up for an adventure. He needs a family who can provide lots of supervision and training as he grows up.
